verdict.rationale: AngelList ships AI features such as the Tie Out Assistant, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client, and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or use external MCP servers. The HRIS integrations and llms.txt are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
